title: Audit the exact sector boundary of the five-in-fourteen claim (no new κ)
body:
The retained PR4813 schedule uses a swap-sector identity as an unrestricted local observation. This audit gives an exact counterexample: on x=e1 and a nonzero independent y=e2, either sign produces squared output error 1/2. The all-width formula shows that the step is valid exactly on `T_f x = sigma x`, preserving the underlying PR4743 triangular port.

The source verifier projects its fixtures into sectors and constructs observations directly from `Kx+Ey`; it does not execute the failing unrestricted subtraction. Its retained `diag(C0,...,C0)` observations already have rank 40, and finite dense recovery does not supply an allowed uniformly priced free decoder. A separate tensor-family/coset proof rules out the named missing local correction from only x and C0_f x; it does not exclude a different global decoder or the general five-in-fourteen problem.

Validation: an independent primitive Q(i) construction matches every source operator, checks both separately lifting residual branches, exact defect matrices/norms/ranks, true sector-basis controls, both concrete failures, retained rank 40, and the width-one/width-two distinction. Normal/optimized registered replay, exact source pins, committed-byte/source-history and whitespace checks pass. The observed source primary finite PASS is preserved separately from its wrapper's existing manifest rejection; no frozen file, source manifest, central scientific disposition or selected frontier is changed.

The package credits Pierre-Loic Doulcet/hexapode for the PR4813 claim, Dugongue/PR4743 for the valid native ports, Yiyang/PR4710 for phase/residual identities, lee-phys/PR4688, Jacob Alan Sussman/PR4628 with eumemic and Swapnil Jain, and JoyboyBrian's related tensor-family/coset method. Archival retention is distinguished from independent scientific acceptance. No new kappa, full native/Lean replay or global small-unit impossibility is claimed.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof explanation, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-assistant verification claimed.
